title: DevOps / Cloud Engineer Role Instructions
instructionLines: The candidate is applying for the role of: DevOps / Cloud Engineer.

sections.heading: Core Evaluation Areas Across Levels
lines: 1. Entry-level / New Grad: CI/CD pipeline basics (GitHub Actions/GitLab CI), Infrastructure as Code (Terraform fundamentals), Docker containers, and cloud provider basics.
2. Mid-level: Kubernetes cluster management, Helm charts, Terraform module design, secret management (Vault), automated security scanning, and multi-environment orchestration.
3. Senior: Multi-cloud architecture, zero-trust network topology, cost optimization (FinOps), progressive delivery (ArgoCD, Flagger), and infrastructure reliability.
4. Staff-plus: Strategic cloud platform roadmap, developer productivity engineering, and company-wide infrastructure governance.
